Exercise 11 · Example. New cultural center in the district al-Zaytūn. Original news the municipality has inaugurated yesterday a new cultural center in the neighborhood al-Zaytūn, with a showroom for two hundred places, a children's library and painting and music workshops. In the speech given for the occasion, the mayor said that the center "will be the house of all the inhabitants of the neighborhood," adding that the entrance to most activities will be free. The opening of the center is part of a plan for the development of popular neighborhoods, launched by the municipality last year, which also includes the restoration of schools and the creation of public gardens.
